recognize_zh: 腹水抹片中一個大型細胞團，中央被巨大淡染的空泡（黏液）撐開，三個深染新月形細胞核被擠壓到周邊，形成印戒樣（signet ring）排列，背景乾淨，提示轉移性腺癌伴印戒細胞分化。
features: Large rounded cell group, several times the size of nearby cells
Central voluminous pale, finely vacuolated/mucin-like cytoplasmic space
Three dense, crescentic hyperchromatic nuclei compressed to the periphery
Rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm at the periphery
Clean, paucicellular background; image slightly out of focus, limiting nuclear detail
describe_en: Ascitic fluid smear shows a large, rounded cluster in which a voluminous central pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasmic space compresses three hyperchromatic, crescent-shaped nuclei to the periphery, beneath a rim of basophilic cytoplasm, producing a signet-ring configuration. It is uncertain at this focus whether this represents a single multinucleated cell or a tight cluster of cells around a shared mucin vacuole. The background is otherwise paucicellular, and nuclear detail is limited by focus. Findings are suggestive of metastatic adenocarcinoma with signet-ring cell features; cell block with mucin stains and immunohistochemistry (e.g., cytokeratin, MOC31/BerEP4, calretinin) are required to confirm.

ddx.vs: Degenerative mesothelial vacuoles are usually multiple and small with a central round nucleus and calretinin/WT1 positivity, rather than one large mucin vacuole crushing crescentic nuclei.
Histiocytes have bland reniform nuclei and foamy cytoplasm with CD68/CD163 positivity and are mucicarmine-negative.
Signet-ring lymphoma cells are discohesive, single lymphoid cells with immunoglobulin vacuoles and are CD45/CD20-positive, not cohesive clusters.
